a person's ask of a run over HTTP, one route per command of the orchestrator's table: another try, or with `"round": true` another round of the loop the step closes, on `POST /api/namespaces/:namespace/runs/:name/steps/:step/retry`; an approval at a gate, or of a loop out of rounds as it stands, on `POST /api/namespaces/:namespace/runs/:name/steps/:step/approve`; the new revisions, or with `"base": true` a merge of the base into a loop's work, on `POST /api/namespaces/:namespace/runs/:name/refresh`: named actions of objects' `Api`, served by `apps/api/src/objects/runs.ts`, each handler calling the orchestrator's entry by its exported name with its typed `input`.

terms.meaning: what comes with Nemia, as the api says it: a skill read `from: 'builtin'` (the folder `BUILTIN_SKILLS`, the orchestrator package's skills folder, each found by name, last, by an agent that gives it), the `builtin` servers of a factory's servers read (`BUILTIN_SERVERS`, `packages/agent-orchestrator/servers/`) and the `builtin` rule of an agent's auto list. A builtin skill is a Skill of origin `builtin`, read at `/api/namespaces/<namespace>/skills/<name>?origin=builtin` and copied into your library by `POST /api/namespaces/default/skills/<name>/copy`.

terms.meaning: who a request is from, as the api resolves it before any router is reached (`callerGate`, `apps/api/src/caller/caller.ts`): an agent's session, an agent by the standing token the person minted for it, or the person, by the token it presents as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, or, on the api's own paths, by the board's HttpOnly cookie (`TOKEN_COOKIE`, set by `POST /api/session`, `apps/api/src/server/session.ts`), asked of the orchestrator (`sessionCaller`). What a path needs of a token is `needOf`'s: a page of the board and a pairing none, every route of the api one, loopback included, the MCP port a standing one. A request under an agent's standing token is then held to its floor before its handler runs (`floorHandled`, `apps/api/src/objects/answer-bound.ts`). A token refused, or a header that is no bearer, is a 401 `Unauthorized` with its reason on any route. A handler reads it as `caller` (`Served`, `apps/api/src/layer.ts`), and a proposal's and a delegation's handlers hand it to the orchestrator's programs (`apps/api/src/proposals/`), which judge it: a refusal by who calls is a 403 `Forbidden` with its reason.
the `nemia …` line the api hands the board for a person to copy.

Absent where the body said nothing renamed.

a run's result is on its base, as the package asks it: and the decision's `merge it`. A wait on a run reads that it succeeded (the `succeeded` key of a run waited on and of a run handed as context), never that it merged.

terms.meaning: a metric's kind as Effect names it (`Metric.Metric.Type`: Counter, Frequency, Gauge, Histogram, Summary), read from the api's own registry; a kind the api keeps no value of is answered with its name and type alone.

the api's description of the run object in OpenAPI 3.1, generated from the package's Schema and served on `GET /openapi/v3/nemia/v1`, with the routes of its sub-resources as the command table gives them. A client's types for the object are generated from it; a sub-resource's answer has no Schema in it yet.
what each step and each try carries at the api: its `phase` and its `reason`, the codes a reader groups and compares, and its `message`, the sentence a person reads and nothing compares.

the `?selector=` query of a read of runs or cards (`/api/stats`) and of the feed (`GET /api/feed/stream`): a selector of their labels in the orchestrator's grammar (`team=core`, `team in (core,infra)`, `!team`), given again for another, of which one must take a run or a card; handed to the entry as `selector`, and a malformed one a 422 naming the key. The RunList (`GET /api/runs`, `GET /api/namespaces/:namespace/runs`) takes `labelSelector` in its place, and reads `?selector=` as retired.
a try's `cause` on a step's tries (`StepTry.cause`): why the try was moved behind, one of the run core's `TryCause`, and null on the current try.
a check's verdict at the api, as codes, its `result` and its `exit`, on a step and on its `StepCheck`, null where no check judged it; the word a person reads for it is the board's to draw.

`waitingOnYou`: the steps of a run that wait on a person, in order; `waitingOnYouWords`, the same steps as `nemia ls` names them (`approve plan` for a step at its gate); and, on a run's `--after` wait and its hold, `waitingOnYou` whether only a person ends it.

terms.meaning: the MCP endpoint of the api, `POST /mcp` (`apps/api/src/mcp/port.ts`): Streamable HTTP in both eras of the MCP spec — 2026-07-28, opened by its discover request, and 2025-11-25, opened by `initialize` — each request answered on its own by the SDK's `createMcpHandler`, its tool list cacheable by the caller alone for `PORT_LIST_TTL_MS`; a Hono route beside the OpenAPI routes and the board's pages (`apps/api/src/board/board.ts`), none of them an endpoint of `objects`' `Api`. It needs a person's token, and serves the port tools by calling the `Api`'s own endpoints in-process with the caller's `Authorization`, so every refusal is the api's own.

a tool of the port, one for each endpoint link of the command table (`served`, read by `toolsOf`): named by its verb (spaces as `_`) or its link's `as`, described by the verb's help and usage, its endpoint's description and each key's, its input the endpoint's path, query and payload as one JSON Schema, those words read once for both of Nemia's seats by `objects`' `toolWordsOf` and joined by its `toolDescriptionOf` (`packages/objects/src/tool-words.ts`), and its `readOnlyHint` and `destructiveHint` from the verb's class and the endpoint's method (`toolHints`, `apps/api/src/mcp/hints.ts`); generated in `apps/api/src/mcp/tools.ts`, never listed by hand. A call is sent with its link's `query` for each key it leaves out and a page of `PORT_PAGE` where its endpoint takes `limit`; a list that answers a `Table` is answered as its lines, printed by `objects`' `tableLines` as `nemia` prints them; and its answer is held under the answer bound.

an MCP task of the port (MCP's tasks extension), never the runtime's task: the answer to a modern call that declares the extension, of a port tool whose link says one (`LinkTask`), which the caller reads with the extension's get and may cancel with its cancel (`apps/api/src/mcp/tasks.ts`). A followed one (`upgrade`) is named `<tool>:<id>` and keeps nothing, each read reading the thing again with the reader's token; a held one (`wait`) is asked again in the api's memory under a random id, bound to its creator's token and lost at a restart. Whether a call is answered as one is `taskAnswerOf` (`apps/api/contracts/task-answer.contract.ts`), and where a followed one stands `followedStateOf` (`apps/api/contracts/followed-state.contract.ts`).

the most characters a port tool answers at once, `ANSWER_BOUND` (`apps/api/src/mcp/bound.ts`), its text and any `structuredContent`'s JSON counted together, under the 50,000 characters past which Claude Code saves a tool's result to a file: a page past it is asked again at most half as long, and any other answer past it is refused with how to narrow it, never cut (`answerFit`, proved by `apps/api/contracts/answer-fit.contract.ts`).

one of the three routes a client with no token yet reaches, each named by its method and path (`apps/api/src/caller/paths.ts`, `needOf` in `apps/api/src/caller/caller.ts`): `POST /api/pairings` (a pairing asked), `POST /api/pairings/:id/claim` (a pairing claimed) and `POST /api/links/claim` (a first-visit link claimed). Each needs no token, exposed or not, since each judges its own secret and none answers with the store's data (`anOpenRouteNeedsNone`, `apps/api/contracts/token-need.contract.ts`); every other route of the pairings and the links, the list, the approval and the mint, needs one.

terms.meaning: the board's HttpOnly, `SameSite=Strict` cookie (`TOKEN_COOKIE`) holding a person's token, set by a sign-in or a first-visit link's claim, kept thirty days and set again for as long on each read the person's cookie alone signs in (`cookieRenewed`, `apps/api/src/server/renewal.ts`); ended by Settings' Forget (`DELETE /api/session`) or by its token retired (`nemia token rm`), whose `unknown-token` refusal clears it.
